objective: Verify whether employee Greta Engel is the manager of store 'PowerTool Innsbruck Wilten' and if so, return their email address.

params.employee: lookup from employee_accounts WHERE employee_display_name = 'Greta Engel'
params.store: lookup from stores WHERE store_name = 'PowerTool Innsbruck Wilten'
params.is_manager: check if employee.job_title contains 'Manager' and employee.store_id matches store.store_id

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Greta Engel's management of PowerTool Innsbruck Wilten: {is_manager}. Email: {email}
